name: dynesty
expected_uses: Evidence and posterior baseline with adjustable effort allocation.
limitations: Prior transforms and likelihood-contour exploration need validation; no universal dimensional scaling advantage.
benchmark_status: not_assessed: this literature review establishes no benchmark result
investigation_prompt: Investigate dynesty on a normalized Gaussian and a separated-mode target using repeated seeds. Check posterior coverage and evidence accuracy. Record package version, initialization, total wall time including setup, evaluations and uncertainty before proposing a science campaign.
